notes: PROPAGATE ON enables automatic propagation "for functions, methods, and programs that follow in the compilation group" (§2002:7.2.17.3 GR1; cite.py --check). A fatal condition a SORT raises through an implicit transfer (the OPEN of a missing USING file, I-O status 35) in such a program, checking enabled and no declarative, is propagated as if a GOBACK RAISING LAST EXCEPTION were executed (§2002:14.5.12.1.2 item 3). It used to be swallowed by the 2023-only SORT/MERGE disposition (§2023:14.6.13.1.3 2)); at --std 2002 and 2014 the SORT/MERGE statement and its implicit transfers now follow the general fatal procedure (VCR row 7.80, kb/Work PB5612), so the caller's declarative runs and ends the run unit; the same program at 2023 continues after the SORT (witness pb5612_sort_fatal_io_propagates_by_edition).
